ns2:course.label: Lighting for the Musical Stage
ns2:course.description: Emphasis on lighting design for musicals, opera, and music concerts. Field trips will be made to area productions. Enrollment limited to Theatre majors. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Cost of field trips will be paid by student. Prerequisite: THEA 231, THEA 232, and THEA 435.
